categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
